description: Authoritative internal limits across Engine, Worker, Server, artifact publication and Studio.

entries.whereShown: LOAD compact diagnostics and Worker event stream
entries.suggestedRemediation: Reduce per-event detail; use bounded archived evidence.
entries.suggestedRemediationZh: 精簡每則 Worker 事件內容；較完整的核准證據請存入有界 artifact。

entries.whereShown: Job event consumers and LOAD diagnostics
entries.suggestedRemediation: Use compact result fields and bounded artifact pages.

entries.whereShown: SSE catch-up response and Studio events
entries.suggestedRemediation: Reconnect from a recent cursor or page history; check disk and replay cost before raising retention.
entries.suggestedRemediationZh: 從近期游標重新連線或分頁查閱歷程；調高保留量前先評估磁碟與重播成本。

entries.suggestedRemediation: Bound submitters; review CPU and heap before changing concurrency.

entries.suggestedRemediation: Reduce submission bursts or use bounded scheduled concurrency.
entries.suggestedRemediationZh: 降低提交尖峰，或使用有界排程控制待處理數量。

entries.scope: Configured LOAD worker concurrency; a shared preparation budget limits effective simultaneous LOAD workers to 4.
entries.enforcingBoundary: ServerConfig parser range 1-256 plus cross-field budget of 256 initial connections per Server and 64 per Worker.
entries.suggestedRemediation: Keep LOAD workers within the fixed preparation budget.
entries.suggestedRemediationZh: 維持現行 LOAD worker 數量；增加前先量度全域準備資源需求。

entries.scope: Initial DB/MQ sessions per LOAD Worker
entries.whereShown: Compact LOAD primaryError and preparation report
entries.suggestedRemediation: Reduce distinct initial DB/MQ helper sessions.
entries.suggestedRemediationZh: 減少每個 LOAD 所需的不同 DB／MQ 初始連線數。

entries.scope: LOAD preparation sessions per Worker JVM
entries.suggestedRemediation: Reduce concurrent initialization demand across runs.
entries.suggestedRemediationZh: 減少同一 Worker JVM 內並行初始化的連線數。

entries.whereShown: Compact LOAD primaryError and preparation report
entries.suggestedRemediation: Reduce dependency count and ensure DB/MQ endpoints respond in time.
entries.suggestedRemediationZh: 減少相依服務數量，並先確認 DB／MQ endpoint 能及時回應。

entries.suggestedRemediation: Narrow the query or paginate before raising the cap.
entries.suggestedRemediationZh: 縮小查詢範圍或分頁讀取，再考慮設定允許範圍內的調整。

entries.suggestedRemediation: Select fewer columns or truncate at source when valid.
entries.suggestedRemediationZh: 只選取所需欄位；若符合業務語義，可在資料來源先限制欄位大小。

entries.suggestedRemediation: Reduce DB concurrency or hold time before increasing pool size.
entries.suggestedRemediationZh: 先減少同時查詢數或縮短連線持有時間，再評估連線池大小。

entries.suggestedRemediation: Reduce contention and long transactions before changing the wait.
entries.suggestedRemediationZh: 先降低連線池爭用並縮短交易時間，再評估等待期限。

entries.enforcingBoundary: Bounded message read and result check
entries.suggestedRemediation: Reduce reply payload or use bounded response formatting.

entries.suggestedRemediation: Reduce MQ concurrency before increasing pool size.

entries.enforcingBoundary: MQ pool admission, physical capacity and connection-creation deadline

entries.suggestedRemediation: Check reply latency separately from pool wait.

entries.suggestedRemediation: Reduce concurrency or response time before increasing pool size.
